answer: Use synchronized surprise audits: at random moments the network sends every identity a fresh task, say naming the violet, sable and yarrow items in a new image set, due within 20 seconds. An honest agent spends one burst of compute; an operator running 1,000 fake identities on shared hardware must answer all 1,000 at once, so its peak compute bill scales with every fake. Identities that miss audits lose reward weight, which makes idle sock puppets worthless.
